[[Swiftscale's Shortbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Stsou Swiftscale]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Maishang Hills]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as a [[Naga Shortbow]] [[dye]]d green.
